qcow2.preservation: Each test hashes fixture input files with SHA-256 before and after native reads. Multi-level backing checks include every chain member and the raw oracle. Shared ownership checks also surround independent qemu-img check.

partition.preservation: sfdisk-created GPT disk SHA-256 unchanged after native partition parsing

limitations: Hashes establish unchanged bytes across these read-only fixture tests, not concurrent-source isolation. Frozen whole-Windows source preservation is recorded separately in capture before/after reports.
